name: no2-vendor-bundle
description: Builds the outside code No2 keeps inside the app: Firebase (sign-in + database) and Leaflet (OpenStreetMap). Run: npm install && npm run build

scripts.build: esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=../../js/vendor/firebase.js --legal-comments=external && esbuild node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet-src.esm.js --minify --format=esm --outfile=../../js/vendor/leaflet.js && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.css ../../css/leaflet.css && cp node_modules/leaflet/LICENSE ../../js/vendor/leaflet.LICENSE.txt
